Amentum is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to support the Space Force Range Contract (SFRC). The role develops, tests, and maintains software applications, assists with features and defect resolution, and collaborates with engineering and cross-functional teams.

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers and designers
Learn and apply best practices in software development, security, and performance
Assist in implementation of new features and enhancements
